title: Paper voices manifest
description: The voice packs a reader may download: what each one speaks, what it costs to run, and every file it is made of with the digest Paper checks it against. This schema is the editor-facing restatement of src-tauri/crates/tauri-plugin-voices/src/manifest.rs, which is the enforcement — the manifest is embedded in the binary with include_str!, because a manifest the reader could edit is a digest check that can be edited to pass.

$schema.description: Relative path of this schema, so editors validate the file in place.

version.description: The manifest format this build speaks. A build refuses a manifest it does not know.

id.description: Stable name of the pack on disk and in preferences.

family.description: Which engine reads it. The engine decides what the files mean.

name.description: What the reader sees in Settings.

summary.description: One line under the name, in the reader's terms.

languages.description: Primary language subtags this pack reads, matching kernel.readingVoice's keys.

platforms.description: Where the pack is OFFERED. A build elsewhere does not list it.

minimumMemoryGb.description: Measured peak while rendering, plus headroom. A Mac with less is not offered the pack.

id.description: What the engine is asked for.

note.description: Who the voice is, in one phrase.

path.description: Where the file lands inside the pack. Relative, and no parent steps: this is a path Paper writes.

url.description: Where the bytes come from, pinned to a commit — the 40-character revision is required, so a moving branch cannot be named.

bytes.description: Exact size. A download that ends at a different size is refused.

sha256.description: Checked before the file is promoted out of staging.

licence.description: The licence these bytes arrive under, shown to the reader.

role.description: What the engine does with it.
